provenance_note: Sources studied are recorded privately by the author; no third-party text, prompts or code are reproduced.
validation: Not benchmarked for this release. The projected impact below is an estimate for the Rust Rewrite and Porting Specialist persona, not a measurement. Structural gate (scripts/verify.py) passed at packaging time; the bundled helper scripts have their own tests. A behavioural benchmark is planned.

projected_impact.routine_ports: No change expected: capable models already port straightforward functions correctly.
projected_impact.trap_heavy_ports: Fewer silent behaviour differences expected where meaning changes between languages (integer width and overflow, shifts, lenient parsing, string and Unicode indexing, empty or missing input). Projected range: 0 to +20 percentage points on hidden behaviour tests. The upper bound is the published average gain for compact procedural skills when an agent lacks the procedure; stronger models are expected nearer the low end.
projected_impact.larger_work: More complete, auditable output expected for migrations, cross-language bridges, speed claims and production cutover (plans, decision records, benchmark verdicts, kill switch), which plain agents tend to skip.
projected_impact.cost: Longer runs expected: projected 1.3 to 1.5 times the time of a plain agent. Small ports are kept to the minimum path to limit this.
projected_impact.basis: Published research on procedural agent skills and the author's development testing.

scope_notes: Projected at persona level, not for this skill alone.
Estimates, not measurements: no uplift is demonstrated and none is refuted.
No universal model or harness performance claim.
